commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot to Neo and update documentation
Rename chatbot to Neo, update documentation and add Neo greeting and farewell
Implement echo functionality and exit command
Add task storage and list command
Refactor tasks to use Task class
Java: Move classes into neo package
commitResults.messageBody:
Java classes are in the default package and public APIs lack

descriptive documentation, which makes the project inconsistent with

its Java coding standard.

Move Neo and Task into the neo package and document their public

constructors and methods. Keep the existing chatbot behavior unchanged

while making the source easier to organize and maintain.

The repository uses project-local standards for Java code and Git

history, but the agent guidance does not reference those standards.

Add the Java and Git skills and require them from AGENTS.md so future

code and commit work follows the project's documented conventions.

Claude guidance does not explicitly require the project-local coding

and Git standards.

Require both skills from CLAUDE.md so Claude-assisted work follows the

same project conventions as other agents.
